name: Voxel Raycasting for Block Interaction
definition: A brute-force raycasting algorithm used to determine block intersection for player interaction (breaking/placing blocks). It steps along a ray in fixed increments to find the first solid voxel.
summary: Voxel Raycasting for Block Interaction is a brute-force algorithm that steps along a ray in fixed increments to find the first solid voxel, differing from analytical methods by using discrete sampling.
